project_identity: JadeOS - High-End Trucker Assistance & Broker OS

theme_and_archetype.primary_archetype: Archetype 7 (Electric & Neon) heavily infused with Archetype 5 (Luxury Dark)
theme_and_archetype.rationale: Needs a 'NASA-meets-Tesla' premium AI HUD feel. Avoids cheap cyberpunk by utilizing deep Obsidian blacks, dense glassmorphism, and tactical neon jade accents strictly for functional data points and AI presence.

design_tokens.css_variables_setup: Provide these as a global CSS block and extend tailwind.config.js to use them.

headings.usage: H1/H2, Main KPIs, Driver Status. Gives a wide, technical, authoritative AI OS feel.

body.usage: General UI text, paragraphs, labels. Clean, modern, highly legible.

data_and_mono.usage: ELD Logs, timestamps, GPS coordinates, license plates, detention timers.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Use strict CSS Grids. 'Bento Box' layout for Driver Dashboard (asymmetrical, dense, distinct widget sizes). Split-screen mode: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 with h-screen configuration.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Heavy use of Glassmorphism (bg-black/40 backdrop-blur-2xl border border-white/5). Inner padding must be generous (p-6 or p-8) for broker side, but MASSIVE hit areas for driver side (h-16+ buttons).
spacing_and_layout.corners: Rounded-2xl for main panels to maintain the 'premium automotive HUD' look.

holo_orb_login.description: Apple-Watch-like biometric scanner. Animated concentric SVG rings around a webcam preview.
holo_orb_login.styles: Use standard HTML5 <video> with object-cover inside a perfect circle (rounded-full). Overlay with spinning SVG borders, utilizing stroke-dasharray and Framer Motion's rotate animation. Progress ring fills up based on 'scan' completion.

jade_voice_assistant.styles: A large central div with bg-primary shadow-[var(--glow-jade)]. Idle state: slow scale(1) to scale(1.05) breathing. Listening/Speaking state: generate dynamic audio waveform bars or concentric ripple rings using Framer Motion.

gps_map_split_screen.styles: Left half of the screen. Implement via react-leaflet using a Dark Matter / Midnight tile layer (e.g., CartoDB Dark Matter). Add a glowing primary-colored polyline for the route. Overlay floating glassmorphism badges for 'Weigh Station Bypass' (Green/Red).

eld_log_book.styles: Use Recharts or a custom SVG grid. X-axis: 24 hours. Y-axis: Off-Duty, Sleeper, Driving, On-Duty. Line must be neon primary color with a drop-shadow. JetBrains Mono for time labels.

detention_timer.styles: Massive monolithic typography for the timer (text-6xl+ JetBrains Mono). Glowing border indicating 'Active' state.

bill_scanner.styles: Camera viewfinder interface. Add corner brackets [ ] mimicking a HUD targeting system. Scanning animation: a primary-colored laser line moving up and down.

broker_command_center.styles: Use Shadcn Data Tables with dark theme. Tight rows, clear risk scoring badges (Red/Amber/Green), and line charts (Recharts) for margin optimization.

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a global SVG noise/grain overlay (opacity-20, mix-blend-overlay) over the background to eliminate 'digital flatness' and enforce the tactical OS look.
visual_enhancers.borders: Implement 'Tracing Beam' borders (1px gradients) on critical active elements like the current active load card.

background_textures.description: Dark abstract shimmering texture for deep backgrounds

hero_and_gps_context.description: Cargo truck on dark twilight road
Dark highway at night with car lights

testing_strategy.attributes: Every button, input, toggle, tab, and major view MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., 'data-testid="login-orb-scan-btn"').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install libraries: framer-motion, lucide-react, react-leaflet, leaflet, recharts.
Do NOT use pure #000000 for backgrounds. Use Obsidian/Tinted greys (e.g. #050907).
Do NOT build generic white-card SaaS layouts. Everything is dark-mode first with heavy glassmorphism.
The <html> tag should use data-theme='...' to handle the 5 mood themes. Setup Tailwind to read CSS variables for colors.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide icons, keeping stroke widths consistent (1.5px to 2px for legibility).
For the ELD layout and GPS split screen, utilize h-screen with flex/grid so the driver doesn't have to scroll.
Build the Holo Orb with actual HTML5 video element capturing via navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia (mocked stream if unavailable) masked inside a circle.
